what: Solar row calibration for procedural fill, read from satellite imagery by the Wire Frame Scanner row-field fit (2D FFT per 72 m window plus a brute-force azimuth, pitch and phase sweep, on CuPy with a NumPy witness on 16 central windows).
imagery: Esri World Imagery, zoom 17 (about 0.7 m per pixel); capture dates per sample not checked

rejected.reason: not solar (storage and forecourt samples): no rows to read
panel mask missed the panels (dark arrays under the luminance threshold, or a site in build); the windows it kept were roads and buildings, looked at
pitch 5.0 m with a tight spread: below any plausible table pitch at this zoom, not confirmed on a closer picture, so held back

row_axis.value: north-south; tables face east and west

bearing_deg.range: axial, taken on -90 to 90 deg from north

row_pitch_ceiling_m.meaning: at zoom 17 (0.75 m per pixel) a 96 px window with the DC cut at radius 3 cannot see a pitch above 32 px, about 23.9 m; the brute-force sweep reaches 15 % past that, about 27.5 m. A median of 26 m sits near this ceiling.

independence: The one accepted sample is the same farm the overlay already draws from its baked row file and the planning hints. Agreement with those is consistency between two readings of one farm, not a second source.
corrections: Bearing: the fit read image y as north, which mirrored every bearing (b became 180 - b). Fixed and proved on 18 synthetic stripe fields at 9 known bearings: worst error 1.0 deg after the fix, 90 deg before; the NumPy witness matched the GPU to 0.0 deg on 4 of them. The earlier 177.5 deg mirrors to 2.5 deg; the axial median over the same 449 windows is 1.0 deg.

panel_cover_fraction.meaning: share of each 72 m window the dark-panel mask covers, over windows with cover of at least 0.4 (not ground cover ratio)

half_pitch_share.meaning: share of panel windows whose pitch reads 12 to 16 m (each face read as a row); small, so the median is the full tent pitch

witness.verdict: consistent within one sweep step, not identical

limits: N = 1 is one farm, not a calibration. Procedural must say 'calibrated on 1 imagery sample' until more samples pass. Per-sample values stay private.
